title: Locking Dance Choreography Tutorial for Beginners - Online Dance Class at Home

method.teacher_system: The teacher welcomes the class and introduces the dance style, breaks down moves in small counts with mirror-reversed demonstrations, and then practises the combination with and without music at increasing speeds.
method.signature: Refers to famous cartoon characters like Scooby-Doo and Uncle Sam when naming the moves.

practices.what: Breaks down the first set of locking moves step by step, starting with the arms.
Turns around to show the back view so learners can follow without flipping left and right.
Practises the routine with the music slowly first, then at normal speed.
Introduces the second part of the routine, starting again with feet and muscle lock.

adaptations.difficulty: Moving arms and legs simultaneously can be too much
adaptations.adjustment: Straighten your arms up and down instead

adaptations.difficulty: Keeping up with the fast tempo
adaptations.adjustment: Do a double-time recap to challenge yourself

struggles.theme: Moves seem easy at first but combinations are difficult

clicked.theme: Teacher repeats every move repeatedly making it easy to follow
Clear breakdowns and explanations make learning very accessible

requests.theme: Ask for more beginner dance tutorials

method.limits: Cannot verify if learners successfully perform the routine at home without supervision.
